name: mound_drag
desc: A low flat smear of thick pink paint goo surges forward to one side as something is dragged underneath, the goo piles up in a sloppy wave at the front and leaves a smeared trail behind, then settles. Only goo: no hands, no faces, no objects. Low and flat, wide and sloppy, sticky, wet, glossy, pink marble with yellow streaks. Something is trapped and struggling underneath.
